name: Общий интерфейс и навигация
scope: Shared search input, clearing, keyboard focus, padding hit area and search submission
Five root tabs and aligned headers; role-dependent root navigation
Reusable horizontal filters and caption contrast over bright artwork
Shared pushed/admin/editor chrome and glass fallback source inspection
News/event navigation and reading position through foreground verification
Read coalescing and retained publication data/error states; warning honesty
Regression coverage for startup/auth transitions and profile save/readback

fixes.finding: Window background-tap observers dismissed the keyboard when clearing a SwiftUI search control. The earlier test only asserted that the text was cleared.
fixes.fix: A weakly registered input region protects the complete shared search control from background dismissal. Clearing explicitly retains focus.
fixes.reproduction: SearchBaseline.xcresult: 1 failed, 7 passed; the new keyboard assertion failed before the fix.

fixes.finding: Organization requests and featured-banner management still had handwritten search variants.
fixes.fix: Both now use AppSearchField, including semantic colors, focus, clear and submit behavior.

fixes.finding: Horizontal filter labels could be compressed and ellipsized even though their row scrolls.
fixes.fix: The shared horizontal row measures its contents at natural horizontal size; actual Ukrainian/German screenshots reviewed.

fixes.finding: Caption scrim could be too light for white text and translucent subtitles over bright banner artwork.
fixes.fix: Use a 0.64 black scrim in both themes; contrast test composites white artwork and 0.88-alpha subtitle and asserts at least 4.5:1.

historicalFailureExplanation: InterfaceVerified had one fixture/setup failure: organization queue was empty, so its search control correctly was absent. Added the existing organization-review fixture. AdditionalSearchVerified then passed both real route journeys; production empty-state behavior was unchanged.

visualEvidence.largeText: German shared-search journey uses Accessibility M. Prior auth audit covers XXXL.
visualEvidence.startupCapture: Debug owner fixture, cold launch through root feed. First unrelated recording had an idle home-screen prefix and was not used as launch evidence.

roleCoverage: ordinary user through both themed root journeys
